title: Nonprofit Grant Obligation Evidence Navigator
tagline: A complete-looking grant file can satisfy the last award and fail the one that funded the work.

cards: A familiar program name makes the old checklist feel reusable.
The notice of award is versioned
One new outcome table or condition changes the complete evidence set.
A polished submission omits a current obligation or unsupported cost.
The nonprofit sees the minimum missing proof before human certification.

story.headline: The grant report that is complete for the wrong award
beats: A small nonprofit reuses last year's accepted reporting packet.
The current award adds one participant outcome obligation.
The agent trusts the familiar program name and marks the packet complete.
The obligation graph holds submission and asks only for the missing proof.
